**Best move:** Qxc6+

**Main line:** 
1. Qxc6+ Kb8 
2. Qxa6 and White is up a full bishop (material advantage of +3)

**Motif:** fork (the queen gives check to the king while attacking the undefended bishop on a6)

**Coaching note:**
When your opponent's pieces aren't well defended, look for forcing moves like checks that attack multiple pieces. Here, Qxc6+ forces Black's king to move, leaving the bishop on a6 hanging to capture next move. This "check + undefended piece" pattern wins material decisively. Always scan for which pieces your checks also attack!
